cum_cfo_pat.label: Cumulative CFO / PAT
cum_cfo_pat.strength_template: Robust cash conversion: Cumulative CFO is {value:.2f}x of reported PAT, demonstrating real cash backing behind profits.
cum_cfo_pat.red_flag_template: Poor cash generation: Cumulative CFO is only {value:.2f}x of PAT (below 0.50x threshold), signalling paper accounting profits.

accruals_ratio.label: Accruals Ratio ((PAT - CFO) / Total Assets)
accruals_ratio.strength_template: Conservative accounting: Low accruals ratio of {value:.1%}, meaning earnings are fully supported by cash flows.
accruals_ratio.red_flag_template: High accruals risk: Accruals ratio of {value:.1%} indicates substantial non-cash earnings and aggressive revenue recognition.

beneish_m_score.label: Beneish M-Score
beneish_m_score.strength_template: Clean forensic profile: Beneish M-Score of {value:.2f} (well below -2.50) indicates negligible risk of earnings manipulation.
beneish_m_score.red_flag_template: Earnings manipulation alert: Beneish M-Score of {value:.2f} exceeds -1.78 threshold, flagging significant financial tampering risks.

chg_receivable_days_2y.label: Change in Receivable Days (2-Year)
chg_receivable_days_2y.strength_template: Disciplined collections: Debtor days improved/stable by {value:+.1f} days over the last 2 years.
chg_receivable_days_2y.red_flag_template: Stretching receivables: Debtor days lengthened by {value:+.1f} days over 2 years, tying up capital and raising collection risks.

other_income_share_pbt.label: Other Income as % of PBT
other_income_share_pbt.strength_template: High core earnings purity: Other income accounts for just {value:.1%} of pre-tax profit.
other_income_share_pbt.red_flag_template: Inflated by non-operating income: Other income forms {value:.1%} of PBT, masking weakness in the core operational business.

altman_z_score.label: Altman Z'' Score
altman_z_score.strength_template: Rock-solid solvency: Altman Z'' score of {value:.2f} places the company firmly in the safe zone against financial distress.
altman_z_score.red_flag_template: Distress zone warning: Altman Z'' score of {value:.2f} is under 1.1, signalling balance sheet vulnerability and default risk.

interest_cover.label: Interest Coverage Ratio
interest_cover.strength_template: Comfortable debt servicing: Strong interest coverage of {value:.1f}x operating profit relative to finance costs.
interest_cover.red_flag_template: Tense debt servicing: Interest cover of {value:.1f}x offers thin cushion against rising interest rates or operational downturns.

debt_to_equity.label: Debt to Equity Ratio
debt_to_equity.strength_template: Conservative leverage: Prudent Debt/Equity ratio of {value:.2f} gives ample balance sheet headroom.
debt_to_equity.red_flag_template: Heavily leveraged: High Debt/Equity ratio of {value:.2f} elevates financial leverage and bankruptcy risk.

sales_cagr.label: Sales CAGR
sales_cagr.strength_template: Rapid top-line expansion: Strong revenue CAGR of {value:.1%} reflecting robust industry demand.
sales_cagr.red_flag_template: Sluggish top-line growth: Revenue CAGR of only {value:.1%} trails healthy expansion benchmarks.

pat_cagr.label: PAT CAGR
pat_cagr.strength_template: Powerful bottom-line compounding: Net profit CAGR of {value:.1%} demonstrating strong operating leverage.
pat_cagr.red_flag_template: Weak or negative profit trajectory: PAT CAGR of {value:.1%} shows declining profitability.

roe.label: Return on Equity (ROE)
roe.strength_template: Superior shareholder returns: High ROE of {value:.1%} creating significant shareholder value.
roe.red_flag_template: Sub-par capital efficiency: Tepid ROE of {value:.1%} fails to clear standard hurdle rates.

ebitda_margin_trend.label: EBITDA Margin Trend (2-Year)
ebitda_margin_trend.strength_template: Expanding pricing power: Operating/EBITDA margins expanded by {value:+.1%} over recent years.
ebitda_margin_trend.red_flag_template: Margin compression: EBITDA margins contracted by {value:+.1%}, indicating input cost pressures or loss of pricing power.

fcf_to_pat.label: FCF Proxy relative to PAT
fcf_to_pat.strength_template: True cash compounder: High free cash flow conversion ({value:.2f}x PAT) after funding capex and CWIP additions.
fcf_to_pat.red_flag_template: Capex cash burn: FCF proxy is only {value:.2f}x of PAT due to heavy capital expenditure or CWIP accumulation.

div_payout_vs_cfo.label: Dividend Payout vs Cash Generated
div_payout_vs_cfo.strength_template: Sustainable capital returns: Dividends consume a prudent {value:.1%} of operating cash flows.
div_payout_vs_cfo.red_flag_template: Aggressive dividend distribution: Dividends devour {value:.1%} of operating cash flows, limiting internal reinvestment.

cash_vs_borrowings.label: Cash vs Borrowings
cash_vs_borrowings.strength_template: Substantial liquidity cushion: Liquid cash covers {value:.2f}x of total borrowings.
cash_vs_borrowings.red_flag_template: Low cash liquidity: Cash covers only {value:.2f}x of total borrowings, posing liquidity risks in credit squeezes.
